描述_EN: although symmetry is a basic element of chinese design, the motif of a pair of confronted animals or birds on either side of a plant was not known in china until the opening of the silk routes in the second century b.c. the pattern seen on this embroidery—birds standing on lotus blossoms (a motif derived from buddhist art)—was popular in the early tang period.
描述_ZN: 虽然对称是中国设计的一个基本元素，但在公元前二世纪丝绸之路开通之前，一对对峙的动物或鸟类在植物两侧的图案在中国并不出名。 这幅绣品上的图案--鸟儿站在莲花上（一种源自佛教艺术的图案）--在唐代早期很流行。
